[[File:Point_Nadir.jpg|thumb|Fische's Cove on the Point Nadir's map.]]
'''Fische's Cove''' was located in the [[Point Nadir]], on the [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Resh 9376/Legends|Resh 9376]]. It was a massive cavern right after the [[Jackrab Hole]], that encompassed much of the comet's rear quarter. Artificial gravity was not maintained in the Cove and various junk floated freely in every direction, none oriented toward any horizon in particular. Named after [[Salovan Fische]], the Cove also included area known as the [[Tethers]] and ended near the [[Slips]], a series of docking facilities that led to the inhabitant part of the comet. The [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] that inhabited the Cove were constant concern of [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] alike.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>
